findings.title: Resume postprocessing outside workflow accepted guard can still downgrade positive resume to not_sent
findings.trigger: thread/resume returns a positive official-schema-valid reply, then outer SessionSnapshots.capture rejects retained settings above its 256KiB snapshot budget. The reproduced response contains 4000 short instruction-source paths and is 400109 bytes, below native 12MiB frame limit.
findings.impact: Native resume already ran and may restore native continuation, but the durable receipt becomes not_sent and runtime/thread uncertainty remains false. The explicit continuation check is skipped, local session still requires resume, and UI recovery can misleadingly treat another resume as unsent-safe. Original operation ID remains deduplicated and does not reissue the native call.
findings.reasoning: workflowMutation sets accepted and guards its own validation/project callback, then returns. The thread/resume switch branch runs sessions.capture and refreshContinuation afterward without a positive flag. Its catch marks uncertainty only when the error already says unknown; the real snapshot jsonBytes capacity error defaults to not_sent.

relatedLocations.note: Real 256KiB snapshot validation throws default-not_sent capacity.

refreshContinuation would normalize its own failures to unknown, but is never reached if preceding capture fails.

findings.recommendation: Move capture/continuation into an accepted-protected scope or track resumeAcknowledged immediately when workflowMutation resolves.
